finish_summary:
1) `bulk_discount_percent(50)` incorrectly returns 5 instead of 10%.
2) `parse_coupon` is case‑sensitive and rejects valid lowercase codes such as "save20".
3) `Cart.remove_item` only deletes an item when the remaining quantity is negative; it leaves a zero‑quantity entry, violating the spec that requires removal when quantity reaches 0 or less.
4) `Cart.total` uses the original subtotal to compute shipping_fee even after a coupon discount has been applied; therefore items discounted below the free‑shipping threshold may still be charged shipping, contrary to the specification.
